Agarican, Toxiphage CR 6

XP 2,400
LN Large plant (fungus)
Init -1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +13
Aura stench (DC 20, 15 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 8, flat-footed 18 (-1 Dex, -1 size, +10 natural)
hp 76 (9d8+35)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +3
DR 5/cold iron; Immune plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee slam +7 (1d8+3 plus poison), 2 tentacles +7 (1d6+3 plus poison)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 8, Con 19, Int 4, Wis 13, Cha 10
Base Atk +6; CMB +18, CMD 34
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Stench, Pungent Stench, Toughness, Toxic Stench
Skills Perception +13, Stealth +11
Languages Agaric

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Chemical Mimicry (Ex)

As a full-round action, a toxiphage can absorb a dose of poison into its body, saving it as a sample. It can indefinitely maintain a number of samples equal to its constitution modifier—absorbing a dose over the limit requires the toxiphage to purge an existing sample from its system, destroying it in the process.

Once per day, a toxiphage can create 1d3 doses of one of the poisons it has saved as a sample. Regardless of the poison imitated, this poison takes the form of a sporeball with a leathery rind, though the consistency of the contents ranges from dusty powder to a viscous, honey-like fluid depending on the delivery method of the sample poison. This poison functions in all ways as the poison it was copied from and can be used as a sample by a different toxiphage.

Luminescent Lamella (Ex)

A toxiphage’s bioluminescence is tied to its poison production. When its chemical mimicry ability is ready to be used, the depths of the pockmarks on its fungal sack glow with the light of a torch. While the ability is still recharging, the creature glows with the light of a candle. The poisons a toxiphage carries samples of greatly influence the color of the light.

Poison (Ex)

Slam & Tentacle—injury; save Fort DC 18; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Con; cure 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.

ABOUT

Environment temperate forests or swamps
Organization solitary, pair, or ring (3-8)
Treasure half (primarily poisons)

The towering toxiphages are the walking poison factories of the agaricians. Their squat bodies support a honeycomb-surfaced sack, the pockmarks of which are filled with varying maturities of toxic sporeballs. The ridges between the pockets are caked in a sticky substance, poison in pollen form, and they release an odor that although highly regarded by agaricians is, in fact, a toxic hallucinogen to everyone else.

Slow in both body and mind, toxiphages are typically looked after by other agaricians who use the poison they produce for a variety of different purposes across their society, from the obvious applications such as arming defenders to more surprising uses such as being used for the “written” form of agaric or to carry a backup supply of psychic spores. Among prosperous blooms, some toxiphages become purely decorative art pieces, with the cultivation of specific shades and patterns of light leading to incredibly deadly and often neglected byproducts.
